title: My Weekend
description: Practise the present simple and like + -ing, and write a message about your weekend.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: On Sundays we ___ to my grandparents' house.
exercises.explanation: With we, use the base verb with no -s: we go.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with is or are.
exercises.text: There ___ a market in our street every Saturday.
answers: is
exercises.explanation: Use "there is" with one thing: there is a market.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I get up late on Saturday.
On Saturday I get up late.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + late + time: I get up late on Saturday.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I like go to the cinema with my friends.
answers: I like going to the cinema with my friends.
I like to go to the cinema with my friends.
exercises.explanation: After like, use the -ing form (or to + verb): I like going.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "our" before a noun to show it belongs to us: our cousins.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: What does you do at the weekend?
answers: What do you do at the weekend?
exercises.explanation: With you, make questions with do, not does: What do you do?

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with a day, also with a day + part of the day: on Sunday morning.

exercises.prompt: Complete with can or can't.
exercises.text: I ___ ride a bike, but I can't ride a horse.
answers: can
exercises.explanation: Use "can" + verb for an ability: I can ride a bike.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My dad watch football on Saturday.
answers: My dad watches football on Saturday.
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it, verbs ending in -ch take -es: he watches.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My cousins have got a big dog.
Have my cousins got a big dog?
exercises.explanation: Use "have got" with plural nouns (they): My cousins have got a big dog.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: We have ___ big lunch on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: Use "a" before a consonant sound: a big lunch.

exercises.prompt: Complete with the negative form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: We ___ (not / get) up early at the weekend.
answers: don't get
do not get
exercises.explanation: With I, you, we and they, make the negative with don't (do not) + verb: we don't get up.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: On Saturday I play tennis ___ go swimming. I can't do both!
exercises.explanation: Use "or" to give a choice between two things.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Sometimes we go to the cinema with my two cousin.
answers: Sometimes we go to the cinema with my two cousins.
exercises.explanation: After a number bigger than one, add -s to the noun: two cousins.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My parents are busy on Saturday.
On Saturday my parents are busy.
Are my parents busy on Saturday?
exercises.explanation: Use "are" with plural nouns: my parents are busy.

exercises.prompt: Write the word in brackets with 's.
exercises.text: We go to ___ (Sam) house on Sunday.
answers: Sam's
exercises.explanation: Add 's to a name to show that something belongs to that person: Sam's house.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: There ___ lots of people in the park on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: Use "there are" with plural nouns: there are lots of people.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The weekend are my favourite time.
answers: The weekend is my favourite time.
Weekends are my favourite time.
The weekends are my favourite time.
exercises.explanation: Use "is" with one thing (the weekend) and "are" with more than one.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I can stay up late.
Can I stay up late?
exercises.explanation: Subject + can + verb: I can stay up late.

exercises.prompt: Write in, on or at.
exercises.text: I get up ___ ten o'clock on Sunday.
answers: at
exercises.explanation: Use "at" with clock times: at ten o'clock.

task.prompt: Your friend asks, "What do you do at the weekend?" Write a message to answer.
contentPoints: Say what you do on Saturday.
Say what you do on Sunday.
Say who you spend your weekend with.
Ask your friend about their weekend.
task.modelAnswer:
Hi Kate,

On Saturday I get up late and play tennis with my brother. In the afternoon I go to the cinema with my friends. On Sunday we visit our grandparents. I like Sundays because Grandma makes cake. What do you do at the weekend?

Jack
